isolation: Darwin sandbox-exec denies writes outside its unique temporary root; runtime processes use env -i with explicit PATH/HOME/TMPDIR/XDG values and bounded process-group timeouts.
cliRoster: unverified: final probe skips CLI because its pinned state-lock path is hardcoded to /tmp outside the strict temp-root sandbox

stateLockSource.resolution: resolveStateLifecycleRuntimeDirectory returns /tmp on non-Windows; TMPDIR and HOME do not affect it
